newsitem.title: UK: UK GILTS BOUNCE UP WITH BUNDS, EXPECT RATE RISE.
newsitem.headline: UK GILTS BOUNCE UP WITH BUNDS, EXPECT RATE RISE.

text.p: UK government bond (gilt) futures made early gains with other international bond markets but then gave back some ground following surprise news that the monthly monetary meeting had been brought forward to this morning.
"People are on tenterhooks but I think it's fairly obvious they're going to put rates up," one senior gilt trader said.
The monetary meeting was due on Wednesday and was widely expected to result in a rise in Britain's 6.0 percent official interest rates.
By 0753 GMT, LIFFE June gilts were up 3/32 at 111-7/32 whilst June short sterling was down 0.04 at 93.31.
